description: Get the ordered App Store listing screenshots for a library app, including markdown images a vision model can inspect. Pass country (jp, de, ...) for that storefront's screenshots and in-app events. Index is 1-based and matches /apps/:slug/screens/:index. Without Library Pro this returns the first 3 US screenshots. Other countries and the rest are $19 a month.

country.description: App Store country for the localized listing, e.g. jp, de, fr, kr, cn, br, es, it, sa. Default us. get_directory_app lists which storefronts exist.

name: get_directory_screens
title: Get directory screens
